hook: Thulium-169 absorbs gamma rays more strongly near its peak than earlier data and evaluations said
hook_turn: than earlier data and evaluations said
summary: Researchers measured how often thulium-169 emits a neutron after absorbing laser-Compton gamma rays, from threshold up to 14.61 MeV. Their values match earlier data below 12 MeV but are significantly higher near the peak. Feeding the updated rates into a 20 solar-mass supernova model barely changes the predicted abundances of p-nuclei, so the astrophysical impact is small.
title: Measurement of the $^{169}$Tm$(\gamma,n)$$^{168}$Tm Cross Section and Implications for $\gamma$-Process Calculations
